name: Miri Marathon 2027
short_description: The Miri Marathon returns to Sarawak on Sunday 21 March 2027, with distances from 5 km up to the full marathon.
ai_summary: The Miri Marathon is scheduled for Sunday 21 March 2027 in Miri, Sarawak, on the northern coast of Malaysian Borneo. It is AIMS-sanctioned and built around the full marathon, with a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km races alongside. Distances are those of the most recent edition; the 2027 line-up has not been published yet. Earlier editions have started from Jalan Merpati in the centre of Miri.

faqs.question: When is the Miri Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Sunday 21 March 2027, in Miri, Sarawak. Miri sits on the coast of Malaysian Borneo near the Brunei border, and the race is one of three AIMS-sanctioned marathons in Sarawak, alongside Kuching and the Sarawak Energy Marathon.

faqs.question: What distances does the Miri Marathon offer?
faqs.answer: The full 42.195 km marathon is the headline distance, with a half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km run alongside it. These are the distances from the most recent edition; the 2027 categories and entry fees have not been announced.
